pages.scene: One single ankylosaurus standing low on four short legs, seen from the side facing left, its whole back covered in rows of bony plates and knobs, and a large round bony club at the tip of its tail. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges. The object floats on this flat colour: it casts no shadow and rests on no ground, and there is no darker patch, wash, puddle, base, line or platform of any kind underneath it.
